basic_info.description: Darling mid-century home in the hills of Miraloma Park. Expansive westward views are showcased from the living room and dining area. A fireplace gives the bright living room a nice refined feel. Both bedrooms are spacious. The kitchen is tastefully updated. Beautiful hardwood floors cover most of the main level. The terraced backyard offers a serene outdoor experience. Plenty of space for parking or expansion possibilities are found in the garage, which also features a great view. The roof was replaced in 2022. If you are looking for a move-in ready home in a quintessential Miraloma location, look no further than 512 Bella Vista.
